title: Generate Your Counterfactuals: Towards Controlled Counterfactual Generation for Text

bias_targets.methodology: Generating counterfactual text by perturbing specific Named Entity tags (e.g., changing locations like 'London' to 'Chicago') and evaluating whether the downstream model's prediction changes (Label-Flip Score) using the DBpedia dataset.

Generating counterfactual text that enforces a sentiment change (e.g., negative to positive) using a differentiable score function, and measuring the Label-Flip Score on sentiment classifiers using the Yelp dataset.
Generating counterfactual text that shifts the semantic topic of the input (e.g., from 'World' to 'Sci-Fi') to evaluate label flipping in topic classifiers using the AgNews dataset.
